summary: TVS Motor Company reported a 44% jump in Q2FY27 revenue to ₹17,103 crore and PAT up 52%. The board also approved a composite scheme to demerge its consumer finance business.

headline: HCL Tech launches AI-driven centers on AWS for GCCs
summary: HCL Technologies launches AI-driven centers on AWS targeting established GCCs and mid-market companies, as part of its GCC 360 solution suite to expand enterprise AI adoption.

headline: NLC India Renewables wins 300 MW wind tender from GUVNL
summary: NLC India Renewables secured a tender for 300 MW wind power projects from GUVNL and was named winning bidder for 100 MW with a greenshoe option approved.

headline: Vardhaman Acrylics Q2 net profit more than doubles YoY
summary: Vardhaman Acrylics reported Q2 consolidated net profit of 52B rupees, compared to 24B rupees in the same period last year, reflecting strong year-on-year growth.

headline: Vedanta Aluminium Q2 EBITDA falls 2% QoQ
summary: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Ltd reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹101 billion, down from ₹103 billion in Q1. Margins contracted to 45.30% QoQ but rose significantly YoY.

headline: Symphony Ltd reschedules Q2FY27 results call to 3 pm
summary: Symphony Limited has revised the timing of its Q2FY27 results conference call. The session with Nirmal Bang Institutional Equities is now set for October 29, 2026, at 3:00 PM IST.

headline: LWS Knitwear AGM set for Nov 20; board approves book closure
summary: LWS Knitwear Ltd scheduled its AGM for November 20, 2026. The board approved a book closure from November 14 to 20 and reappointments of key directors.

headline: Concord Biotech to hold investor meet in Singapore
summary: Concord Biotech Limited will participate in a UBS-hosted Non-Deal Roadshow in Singapore on November 3 and 4, 2026. Discussions will rely solely on publicly available information.

headline: Sharp Investments proposes share swap to acquire RLCPL
summary: Sharp Investments Ltd plans to issue 27.51 crore equity shares via share swap to acquire 100% of Rajal Lefin & Commercial Private Limited, retracting other corporate objectives.

headline: Kiri Industries subsidiary completes Makilala Mining stake acquisition
summary: Equinaire Holdings, a wholly owned subsidiary of Kiri Industries, has completed the acquisition of a 40% stake in Makilala Mining Company via public auction.

headline: MAS Financial Q2 net profit rises to ₹1.13 billion
summary: MAS Financial Services reported a consolidated net profit of ₹1.13 billion in Q2, up from ₹903.4 million YoY. Revenue grew to ₹5.9 billion from ₹4.8 billion.

headline: Hyundai Motor India Q2 domestic volume up 18.8%
summary: Hyundai Motor India's Q2 domestic volume growth of 18.8% significantly outpaced its FY27 guidance of 8%-10% YoY, signalling strong near-term demand momentum.

headline: Martin Burn Q2FY27 net profit falls 39% YoY
summary: Martin Burn Ltd reported a standalone net profit of ₹35.96 lakh for Q2FY27, down 38.9% YoY. Revenue from operations stood at ₹2.84 lakh, while other income contributed significantly to total income.

headline: Kkalpana Plastick board approves Q2FY27 results, change in control
summary: Kkalpana Plastick Ltd. board approved Q2FY27 results and noted completion of open offer by Ashish Begwani. Control shifts to Begwani from November 3, 2026.

headline: TVS Motor acquires STPL for ₹530.08 crore
summary: TVS Motor Company Limited approved the acquisition of 100% stake in STPL Trading and Services Private Limited for ₹530.08 crore, a related party transaction.

headline: Meenakshi Ltd gets new ISIN for share split
summary: Meenakshi (India) Limited received confirmation from NSDL and CDSL for a new ISIN following the sub-division of equity shares from ₹10 to ₹5. The split is effective October 30, 2026.

headline: Progrex Ventures board to review Q2FY27 results, KMP changes
summary: Progrex Ventures Limited board meeting on November 12, 2026, will approve Q2FY27 results and record resignations of CEO and directors.

headline: Vishnu Chemicals halts Vizag plant for integration
summary: Vishnu Chemicals Limited announced a temporary stoppage of its Visakhapatnam Parwada plant from October 28, 2026. The halt facilitates synchronization of forward integration and new capital projects.

headline: Goodluck India Q2FY27: Revenue up 38%, EBITDA up 31%
summary: Goodluck India reported 38% YoY revenue growth to ₹1,374 crore in Q2FY27, driven by 18% volume growth. Net profit rose 19% to ₹50.7 crore.

headline: VST Industries Q2 revenue jumps, profit dips
summary: VST Industries reported a significant rise in Q2 revenue to ₹8.44 billion, but net profit fell to ₹410 million as EBITDA margins contracted sharply.

headline: Piramal Finance seeks shareholder nod for Dinesh Kumar Khara as Independent Director
summary: Piramal Finance Limited has issued a postal ballot notice seeking member approval for the appointment of Dinesh Kumar Khara as an Independent Director for a five-year term.

headline: Seamec barge Glorious on hire from Oct 26
summary: Seamec Limited announced that its barge Seamec Glorious was considered on hire effective October 26, 2026, at 23:15 hrs. This follows the completion of dry docking.

headline: Awfis adds 1.45 lakh sq ft premium workspaces
summary: Awfis Space Solutions launches new centres in Pune, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, adding ~1.45 lakh sq ft of chargeable area to its portfolio.

headline: PNC Infratech Q2FY27 PAT falls 16% YoY
summary: PNC Infratech reported a 15.8% YoY decline in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27. Revenue rose 17.3% YoY, but margins compressed due to higher finance costs and operational expenses.

headline: GIC Housing Finance appoints Lavanya Mundayur as director
summary: GIC Housing Finance appoints Lavanya Mundayur, CMD of New India Assurance, as Additional Non-Executive Director effective October 28, 2026.

headline: Sigma Advanced Systems to host ICICI Securities investor meet
summary: Sigma Advanced Systems Limited will hold in-person individual meetings with investors organized by ICICI Securities on October 30, 2026, in Mumbai.

headline: Restile Ceramics shareholders approve BGCL acquisition
summary: Restile Ceramics Ltd shareholders approved the acquisition of 98.89% equity in Bell Granito Ceramica Limited via a share swap and cash deal during an EGM held on October 28, 2026.

headline: Peshwa Wheat H1FY26 revenue up 18% to ₹129 crore
summary: Peshwa Wheat Limited reported unaudited revenue of ₹129 crore for H1FY26, an 18% increase from ₹109 crore in the corresponding period last year, driven by core processing activities.

headline: Bandhan Bank Q2FY27 PAT jumps 456% YoY
summary: Bandhan Bank reported a five-fold jump in quarterly net profit to ₹622 crore. NII rose 14% YoY while asset quality improved significantly.

headline: Satin Creditcare Q2FY27 PAT jumps 231% YoY
summary: Satin Creditcare Network reported a 231% YoY surge in standalone net profit to ₹17,161 lakh for Q2FY27. Consolidated profit rose 231% to ₹17,590 lakh.

headline: CL Educate submits 30th AGM minutes
summary: CL Educate filed minutes of its 30th AGM held on September 29, 2026. Shareholders approved audited financials for FY26 and re-appointed key directors including Nikhil Mahajan.

headline: Shalimar Paints Q2FY27: Loss widens to ₹32 crore
summary: Shalimar Paints reported a standalone net loss of ₹31.99 crore for Q2FY27, widening from ₹13.87 crore in Q2FY26. Revenue from operations fell 13% YoY to ₹114.52 crore.

headline: Kuantum Papers Q2FY27 net profit falls 61% YoY
summary: Kuantum Papers reported a 61% YoY decline in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹2.24 crore due to planned shutdowns. Revenue remained flat at ₹279.10 crore.

headline: Gateway Distriparks board approves revised UPSI code
summary: Gateway Distriparks Limited's board approved a revised Code of Practices for Fair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information on October 28, 2026, enhancing compliance with SEBI PIT Regulations.

headline: Gretex Corporate fined ₹8 lakh by SEBI
summary: SEBI imposed an ₹8,00,000 penalty on Gretex Corporate Services for due diligence lapses in the Taurian MPS IPO. The regulator cited contraventions of ICDR Regulations, 2018.

headline: AIA Engineering sets Nov 3 earnings call
summary: AIA Engineering will host a conference call on November 3, 2026, to discuss Q2FY26 results. Management will address investor queries on financial performance.

headline: Sanco Trans hit with ₹15.98 lakh customs penalty
summary: Sanco Trans Limited received a recovery and penalty order of ₹15.98 lakh from the Commissioner of Customs, Trichy, for alleged duty drawback violations under the Customs Act.

headline: Rajputana Stainless promoter group gifts 90,000 shares
summary: Jayesh Natvarlal Pithva gifted 90,000 shares to three family members. The inter-se transfer involves no cash consideration and leaves the total promoter holding unchanged.

headline: GSK Pharma to host analyst meet on Nov 4
summary: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals will hold a digital group meeting for investors and analysts on November 4, 2026. The company confirmed the schedule in a filing to stock exchanges.

headline: KPR Mill to hold virtual meeting with 360 One
summary: KPR Mill Limited announced a one-to-one virtual meeting with 360 One Capital Market Private Limited scheduled for November 3, 2026. The company confirmed no unpublished price-sensitive information will be discussed.

headline: Adjia Technologies exempt from RPT disclosures
summary: Adjia Technologies Ltd stated that Related Party Transaction disclosures under SEBI LODR Regulation 23(9) are not applicable for H1FY27 due to its BSE SME listing status and capital thresholds.
